'''Bili Mandair''' is a boy born during the [[Aiel War]].

==History==
Bili was born in Lord [[Ellisar]]'s camp on the day of [[Gitara Moroso]] [[foretelling]] to a woman named [[Willa Mandair|Willa]]. [[Moiraine Damodred]] adds his name to her list of candidates for the [[Dragon Reborn]].{{ref/book|0|6}}
